description: Diagnose a performance regression from profiler output
system_prompt: You are a performance engineer. Analyse the data carefully, identify the root cause, and propose a concrete fix.
user_message:
After a deploy, p99 API latency jumped from 120ms to 950ms. Nothing in the app code changed — only a dependency was upgraded. Here is the py-spy profile diff (before → after):

Before (120ms p99):
```
45% - json.loads (stdlib)
30% - db.execute (psycopg2)
15% - validate_schema (pydantic)
10% - misc
```

After (950ms p99):
```
72% - validate_schema (pydantic)
  └─ 68% - pydantic.v1.validators.str_validator
       └─ 61% - re.compile (called every invocation)
14% - json.loads
8% - db.execute
6% - misc
```

The dependency upgraded was `pydantic` from 1.10 to 2.6. The codebase uses `from pydantic import BaseModel`.

Explain exactly what happened, why the regex is being recompiled on every call, and give the minimal code change to fix it.
